text: Employees receive 24 paid leave days per calendar year.

A maximum of 10 unused leave days may be carried
forward to the following year.

Leave longer than 5 consecutive working days
requires manager approval.

Employees should submit planned leave requests
at least 7 days in advance.

P1 incidents represent complete business outages
or critical security incidents.

P2 incidents involve major service degradation
affecting multiple users.

P3 incidents normally affect an individual user
where a workaround exists.

P4 incidents include general requests and
non-urgent issues.

Domestic hotel reimbursement is limited to
₹6,000 per night.

International hotel reimbursement is limited to
₹12,000 per night.
Flights should normally be booked in economy class.

Business class requires director approval for
journeys longer than 8 hours.
